name: Krypto the Superdog
description: Krypto, the Superdog, chronicles the comedic canine adventures of Metropolis' day-saving superdog from Planet Krypton. Krypto jettisons to Earth after traveling across the galaxies as a test-pilot puppy aboard a malfunctioning rocket ship built by Superman's father. Landing astray on unfamiliar terrain, the fully-grown Krypto swiftly seeks out companionship on Earth and flips over Kevin Whitney, a young boy who too longs for friendship. With an amazing array of super hero powers, ranging from heat vision to super strength to flying, Krypto partners with best pal Kevin to fight evil forces that threaten the safety and well-being of the people and animals of Metropolis.

videos.title: Krypto's Scrypto
videos.overview: After his spaceship malfuntions, Krypto arrives on Earth and immediately befriends a young boy named Kevin who takes him in.

videos.title: Super-Flea
videos.overview: A flea from the planet Krypton gives Krypto one super itch.

videos.title: A Bug's Strife
videos.overview: Lex Luthor's pet lizard uses a growth ray to turn a caterpillar into a giant monster!

videos.title: Meet the Dog Stars
videos.overview: A group of superdogs from outerspace come to earth to catch a villainous cat who has been wreaking havoc all over the cosmos.

videos.title: The Streaky Story
videos.overview: Ever wonder how Streaky got Krypto's powers? This story reveals that secret!

videos.title: Diaper Madness
videos.overview: Kevin and Krypto have to babysit Melanie while Kevin's Mom is away. But when a teleporter device ends up in Melanie's diaper, complete madness abounds.

videos.title: Feline Fatale
videos.overview: Streaky feels neglected when Andrea adopts a new cat named Delilah.

videos.title: Dog-Gone Kevin
videos.overview: After founding red kryptonite for the very first time, Krypto and Kevin switch bodies, and each of them found how great is to be the other, or is it?

videos.title: The Dark Hound Strikes!
videos.overview: Ace the Bat Hound arrives in Metropolis and enlists Krypto's help to track down and stop Joker's Hyenas latest scheme.

videos.title: My Pet Boy
videos.overview: Kevin learns to take it easy on dogs, even if they have super-powers like Krypto, when he becomes a pet for a giant male dog.

videos.title: Dem Bones
videos.overview: When the normal dogs imitate other animals, they discover Mechanikat and Snooky are up to trouble, and Mechanikat exposes Krypto to Kryptonite, and it's up to Streaky to save the day.

videos.title: Bat Hound for a Day
videos.overview: When Krypto is rendered powerless by the effects of red kryptonite, Ace the Bat Hound gives him a bat collar so they can track down the Penguin's birds.

videos.title: Dogbot
videos.overview: Kevin uncovers a Kryptonian robot dog inside Krypto's spaceship, but this new friend only wants to play with Krypto.

videos.title: Old Dog New Tricks
videos.overview: When Krypto and Streaky meet up with a fire Dalmatian named Smokey, who has the worried of a new puppy on his mind. Streaky assumes the new dog is a Smokey "replacement", much to Krypto's disbelief. Streaky gets the bright idea to use Krypto as Smokey's super-double.

videos.title: Talk to the Animals
videos.overview: During a super loop in mid-air by Krypto, Kevin loses his communicator. It falls in the zoo, where Bernie, the Zoo Keeper discovers the the device, and accidentally gets tricked by a nasty little monkey. It's up to Krypto and Bernie get all of the animals back to the zoo.

videos.title: My Uncle the Superhero
videos.overview: Streaky wants to impress his nephew, Squeaky, by making him believe he is a big-time superhero.

videos.title: Top Dog
videos.overview: A movie star dog wears a super-powered suit after making a pact with Snooky.

videos.title: Puss in Space Boots
videos.overview: Krypto is missing and it's up to Streaky the Cat to rescue him.

videos.title: Teeny Tiny Trouble
videos.overview: Two little aliens have a VERY BIG problem. Their spaceship is broken and they need to make repairs before they can refuel it. They decide to turn to two earth beings for help, namely Kevin and Krypto. Unfortunatly, the only way the aliens can get Kevin and Krypto's attention is to shrink them down to their size.

videos.title: Dogbot to the Rescue
videos.overview: Streaky programs Dogbot to help Krypto so he can have more time with Kevin.

videos.title: Bad Bailey
videos.overview: Kevin's nasty cousin Bailey blackmails him when he finds out about Krypto.

videos.title: Bat Hound's Bad Luck
videos.overview: Catwoman's cat, Isis, steals a cursed gem that causes Ace to run into a string of bad luck.

videos.title: Circus of the Dog Stars
videos.overview: Snooky uses brain-washing collars to make the Dog Star Patrol preform in a space circus.

videos.title: The Living End
videos.overview: Red kryptonite causes Krypto's tail to detach from his body.

videos.title: The Dog Days of Winter
videos.overview: Ignatius changes the weather, making it summer during the winter.

videos.title: Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: Ignatius creates a formula to grow super hair.

videos.title: The Cat and the Bat
videos.overview: Bat Hound and Streaky must team up when Krypto is away.

videos.title: Melanie's Monkey
videos.overview: Melanie learns that monkeys belong in the rainforest when she encounters one.

videos.title: Funny Business
videos.overview: Bat Hound becomes too silly to fight crime after being affected by laughing gas.

videos.title: Now You See Him...
videos.overview: Streaky accidently gets the power of invisibility. However, he soon learns the about the problems it causes.

videos.title: Bones of Contention
videos.overview: When the Dog Stars get some chew toys, they begin to get on each other's nerves.

videos.title: Superdog? Who's Superdog?
videos.overview: Krypto gets amnesia due to red kryptonite and can't remember who he is. The Junkyard Dogs try to turn him into a bad dog.

videos.title: The Good Life
videos.overview: The Tail-Roping member of the Dog-Stars finds out that Krypto's civilian life is practically paradise and decides to become an Earth dog citizen himself, only to find out that the grass isn't always greener on the other side.

videos.title: Streaky's Super Cat Tale
videos.overview: Streaky tells a tall tale to his fan club.

videos.title: The New Recruit
videos.overview: Drooly applies for membership in the Dog Star Patrol.

videos.title: Up, Up and Away
videos.overview: Ignatious creates a formula that makes people levitate like balloons!

videos.title: Dinosaur Time
videos.overview: Ignatious uses a time machine to travel back in time to the period of the Dinosaurs, but Krypto and Kevin come back with him.

videos.title: Puppy Problems
videos.overview: Mechanikat turns the Dog Stars into puppies.

videos.title: Switching Sides
videos.overview: Krypto is forced to team up with Ignatius to investigate thefts at Lexcorp.

videos.title: Leaf of Absence
videos.overview: Krypto and Ace take on a mutant dog-plant hybrid who is stealing all the trees in Metropolis.

videos.title: Big Sister
videos.overview: An alien growth ray turns Melanie into a 50-foot giant toddler.

videos.title: Bat Hound Meets the Dog Stars
videos.overview: While the Dog Stars are repairing their ship on Earth, Krypto introduces them to Ace. He is soon mocked because he doesn't have any powers of his own, so he leaves. However, when Snooky abducts Hot Dog without leaving a trace, Ace may be the only one the Dog Stars can count on.

videos.title: A Dog's Life
videos.overview: Tired of living like a rat, Jimmy disguises himself as a dog. But when Mutsy's group wants him to join them, he may be in over his head.

videos.title: Stray for a Day
videos.overview: A royal cat takes the day off with Streaky, allowing Isis the opportunity to steal the Queen's jewels.

videos.title: Ruffled Feathers
videos.overview: Krypto becomes jealous when he thinks Kevin likes Bat Hound more than Superdog.

videos.title: Bat Hound and the Robin
videos.overview: Bat Hound is at his wit's end when a feisty Robin decides to become his crime-fighting partner.

videos.title: Furry Fish
videos.overview: Krypto and Streaky have an undersea adventure when red kryptonite turns them into fish.

videos.title: Tusky's Tooth
videos.overview: Tusky looses his tooth and the Mechanicat is after it.

videos.title: When Penguins Fly
videos.overview: Waddles, the Penguin's penguin steals Streaky's superpowers.

videos.title: Storybook Holiday
videos.overview: Kevin learns a lesson about the importance of family when he and Krypto are magically transported to Storybook Land, where the characters resemble Kevin's relatives.

videos.title: Kids in Capes
videos.overview: Andrea exposes Krypto to a piece of red kryptonite by accident, which accidentally gives Kevin and Andrea powers when they touch him. It's up to Krypto and Streaky to make sure they stay safe.

videos.title: Attack of the Virtual Vegetables
videos.overview: Kevin plays one of his dad's old video games on Krypto's rocket computer. But when he gets transported into the game, Krypto and Streaky have to help him fight his way to the end.

videos.title: Mechani-Bot
videos.overview: When Mechanikat creates a robot double of himself, he soon finds that his creation has a mind of its own. He's left with only one option...ask the Dog Stars for help.

videos.title: Stretch-O-Mutt to the Rescue
videos.overview: A guard dog for STAR Labs, named Buddy, slips into a vat of elastic chemicals and is able to stretch and mold his body. Can he help Superdog recover a stolen robot?

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Mechanikat uses an aging ray on Superdog, but accidentally hits Kevin in the process as well. Can they restore their bodies back to normal?

videos.title: K-9 Krusader
videos.overview: Thundermutt asks Ace if he can study the way Ace fights crime so he can perform his new movie. Ace soon realizes the pain of helping him out.

videos.title: Andrea Finds Out
videos.overview: Andrea follows Streaky into Krypto's clubhouse and finds out both superheroes' secrets. Meanwhile, Mechanikat creates a Dirtbot on Earth to steal jewels and uses kryptonite against Krypto and Streaky! It's up to Kevin and Andrea to destroy the Dirtbot.

videos.title: Reptile Round-Up
videos.overview: When Ignatius gets bored, he clones himself with a new Lexcorp device. But when the machine gets out of control and creates endless clones of him, Superdog has to fetch them all.

videos.title: Reptile Round-Up
videos.overview: When Ignatius gets bored, he clones himself with a new Lexcorp device. But when the machine gets out of control and creates endless clones of him, Superdog has to fetch them all.

videos.title: Streaky's Field Trip
videos.overview: The Supercat Fan Club wants to go on a field trip with Streaky. The Penguin's birds, however, have other plans for the heroes...

videos.title: Pied Pussycat Piper
videos.overview: Isis steals a magical pipe that can control animals and uses it to rob stores in Metropolis. When Ace and Krypto end up under her spell, Jimmy the rat has to fight her off.

videos.title: Solar Specs
videos.overview: Mechanikat blocks out the yellow rays of the sun with his new satellite, creating red light instead. When Krypto and Streaky become powerless, Stretch-O-Mutt has to save the day!

videos.title: Too Many Cooks
videos.overview: Mammoth Mutt, Tail Terrier, and Paw Pooch compete for temporary leader when Brainy gets put to sleep by sleeping gas.

videos.title: Join the Club
videos.overview: In order to find Krypto's secret rocket, Mechanikat sends Snooky in disguise to infiltrate the Supercat Fan Club. He soon comes to like his new friends, however...

videos.title: Bailey's Back
videos.overview: Bailey returns to prove Krypto's secret identity as Superdog. Only this time, Andrea has to help Kevin keep the secret when he finds out about Supercat.

videos.title: Streaky's Inner Struggle
videos.overview: Peek and Pleek return to show Krypto and Kevin their latest criminal capture, named Plunk. But when Plunk escapes, a chase leads Krypto and Plunk into Streaky's body...

videos.title: Face Time
videos.overview: Stretch-O-Mutt is so excited to see the Dog Stars, however a pod enters with a space virus and infects the Dog Stars... except Krypto and Stretch-O-Mutt. To make things worse, the Dog Stars ship is struck by a Kryptonite ray. With all the Dog Stars sick, a weak Krypto and Stretch-O-Mutt must fool Mechanikat into thinking the Dog Stars aren't infected before Mechanikat and Snooky take over the ship!

videos.title: Catopia
videos.overview: Krypto is hit with a Cat-a-beam that makes him act and think like a cat! It turns out Mechanikat has conquered a planet and turned it into Catopia. Streaky finds the planet and thinks it's "heaven". Ironically, so does Krypto when he is forced to come with Mechanikat and be brainwashed. Streaky must find some way to change Krypto back, or Krypto will think he's a cat for the rest of his life.

videos.title: The Parrot and the Pirates
videos.overview: When a parrot named Blackbeak and his rat pirate crew cause trouble in Metropolis, Streaky and Stretch-O-Mutt team up to put a stop to them. It seems like an easy task, but Blackbeak's pendant holds a special power.

videos.title: Robbie's Return
videos.overview: "Robbie the Bird Wonder" returns from the South, only to get a jumpstart from Bat Hound because his superheroing hasn't been doing well. Both Robbie and Streaky notice that Krypto and Bat-Hound is missing, however, but manage to find where they are with Krypto wearing kryptonite over his neck and Bat-Hound tied to Krypto on a rocket. Streaky tries to save them, but gets caught as well. It turns out Isis and Mechanikat have teamed up, so now Robbie will have to save the day, despite having a bad time rounding up crooks.

videos.title: Revolt of the Beavers
videos.overview: While away at Summer Camp, Kevin overhears some beavers talking about conquering the humans. After following them, Kevin finds out that they are being led by alien beaver, named Buggy, who is helping them build weapons with the trees. After he is captured, he contact Krypto, who, along with Streaky, arrives to help. It's up to Krypto, Streaky, and Kevin expose Buggy's true identity to the beavers.

videos.title: Invasion From the Planet Peanut
videos.overview: While Krypto's away, Streaky joins the Dog Stars on a missions to capture an intergalatic peanut pilferer. When the alien elephant gets away, they follow it to a giant peanut-shaped ship the size of a planet. Can Streaky and the Dog Stars successfully infiltrate the ship and get the peanuts back?

videos.title: Mechani-Calamity
videos.overview: When Mechanikat is rejected as a leader of a club over Glorg, he sets to capture Superdog once again with a very powerful suit of his own. When Krypto and Ace get a distress signal (from their space suits), they land on a planet with Kryptonite dust and soil. With Krypto's weakened powers, will he and Bat Hound defeat Mechanikat's new makeover?

videos.title: Barrump Barrump
videos.overview: Brainy arrives outside Kevin's house, to tell Krypto that a new prankster/criminal is on the loose, so they try to guard a Timestopper, a device that freezes time. Meanwhile Barrump Barrump tries to steal the Timestopper from Kevin, but Kevin uses it to his advantage. Will Kevin's absurd usage of the Timestopper cost him the responsibility of guarding an important device?

videos.title: Iguanukkah
videos.overview: After Kevin learns about the history of Hanukkah from Andrea, Krypto hears an alarm from the Lexcorp building just to find out Ignatious just wanted a toy named "Chippy Snowchip", and wants a ride to the toy store. Ignatious arrives at the stack of toys just to find out there is only one left. When a little girl finds Ignatious, everybody in the store screams. After Krypto repairs the store, he heads to the park to do snowmen. Andrea feels sorry for Ignatious, so she thinks about inviting him. Meanwhile, the snowchips Ignatious lost fall into each of the snowmen, causing the down lights to bring the snowmen to life!
